name: render_undo_roundtrip
description: RU-1: Undo and Redo of render edits, on RD-1. A Pass Editor edit (present draws the fixture's inverting fragment, which the viewport shows) is taken back with Ctrl+Z while the Frame Plan holds the keyboard -- the picture and get_render_authoring_context are what they were -- and put again with the Frame Plan's Redo. Decompose into loop is taken back with Edit > Undo Render Edit (the Frame Plan draws the material pass again, the graph holds no loop), put again with Redo, and taken back once more. Last, Add fullscreen pass writes a file of its own: Undo stops there and says so in one line, sending nothing.
